content.title: South Carolina, Dawn Staley beat TCU, advance to 6th straight Final Four
content.text: Updated March 30, 2026, 11:09 p.m. ETSACRAMENTO, CA — South Carolina women's basketball and coach Dawn Staley are heading to a sixth straight Final Four following a 78-52 victory over TCU in the Elite Eight on March 30.The No. 1 seed Gamecocks (35-3) outscored the No. 3 Horned Frogs (32-6) 29-11 in the fourth quarter to pull ahead, led by freshman Agot Makeer, who finished with a career-high 18 in her first Women's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight.Joyce Edwards finished with a team-high 24 points, 12 rebounds and two blocks in the win. TCU star point guard Olivia Miles ended her college career with 18 points and six assists in the loss.South Carolina will now play UConn in Phoenix on April 3 (7 p.m. ET, ESPN) in a rematch from the 2025 national title game.South Carolina women's basketball vs TCU score Gamecocks up 49-41 heading into fourthAfter making just 4-of-20 field goal attempts in the third, the Gamecocks lead by eight heading into the fourth.Edwards with 18 and 10 rebounds . Olivia Miles leaves court towards end of 3QStar point guard Olivia Miles left the court and was getting checked out by medical staff as the third quarter ended. South Carolina 40, TCU 35: 4:34 left in 3QGamecocks up five at the media timeout. Halftime: South Carolina 35, TCU 27Johnson and Edwards combine for 16 of the Gamecocks' 19 second quarter points. Edwards leads with 14, Johnson with 10.Miles has team-high 11 for TCU, still two fouls. Marta Suarez came out of the game limping late in the second but didn't go back to locker room until halftime.Edwards has six rebounds and three blocks with her 7-of-11 shooting, including the last bucket of the half. Gamecocks respond to TCU's 2Q start with 9-0 runRaven Johnson stole the ball off her own missed layup then found Ta'Niya Latson who threw a beautiful dump pass to Joyce Edwards.That's a 9-0 run for South Carolina after TCU started the second quarter on a 6-0 run. Edwards now has 12 points. South Carolina leads TCU 16-14 after first quarterAn 8-0 run over the last three minutes (15-2 over last five) give the Gamecocks the lead after the first quarter.Joyce Edwards has six points, four rebounds, three blocks and one assist so far. Agot Makeer with a big four points off the bench. TCU starts 6-0 run, South Carolina down 12-6 with 4:16 in 1QThe Horned Frogs jumped out to a quick lead, capitalizing on some missed buckets for South Carolina. Olivia Miles has two fouls early in this game.What time does South Carolina vs TCU start? Where: Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, CaliforniaDate: March 30Time: 9 p.m. ETWhere to watch South Carolina vs TCU March Madness gameTV: ESPN which is available on Fubo, which offers a free trialSteaming: ESPN+How to watch online: Watch ESPN (here's how to stream it live)South Carolina vs TCU injury reportSouth CarolinaChloe Kitts: OutAdhel Tac: OutDid Raven Johnson and Ta'Niya Latson play high school basketball together?Latson is a year younger than Johnson but the two played three seasons together for Westlake in Atlanta.Johnson signed with South Carolina as the No. 2 recruit in the Class of 2021 and Latson transferred to American Heritage High School in Florida for her senior year.Olivia Miles honored by Dawn Staley praiseTCU star point guard Olivia Miles was injured in 2023-24 when South Carolina played Notre Dame and she wasn't at TCU last year when these two programs met. Staley had nothing but praise when asked about Miles."That's awesome, Dawn Staley is such an icon ... High praises, obviously. Excited to compete against her," Miles said. "I've had the utmost respect for her. I love any point guard that's touched the game in a positive way. And seeing what she's done as a player and as a coach, USA Basketball, you name it, she's just incredible. I'm excited to finally meet her tomorrow and play against her team."Where Dawn Staley ranks among coaches with most NCAA women's basketball championshipsGeno Auriemma, UConn (12)Pat Summitt, Tennessee (8)Kim Mulkey, Baylor and LSU (4)Dawn Staley, South Carolina (3)Tara VanDerveer, Stanford (3)Linda Sharp, Southern Cal (2)Muffet McGraw, Notre Dame (2)Dawn Staley's March Madness record at South CarolinaStaley is 52-16 in the NCAA Tournament after winning three games in 2026.Dawn Staley contract, salaryOn Jan. 17, 2025, Staley's became the highest-paid college women’s basketball coach in the history of the sport.Staley's new contract took effect immediately and runs through 2029-30. She's receiving annual salary of $4 million with a $250,000 increase every season and a $500,000 signing bonus that makes the total value approximately $25.25 million.South Carolina women's basketball startersWith all players healthy, coach Dawn Staley's starting lineup is:PG- Raven JohnsonG- Ta'Niya LatsonG- Tessa JohnsonF- Joyce EdwardsC- Madina OkotSouth Carolina women's basketball 2025-26 rosterSenior Raven Johnson - Guard, No. 25Senior Ta'Niya Latson - Guard, No. 00Senior Chloe Kitts - Forward, No. 21Senior Maryam Dauda - Forward, No. 30Senior Madina Okot - Center, No. 11Junior Tessa Johnson - Guard, No. 5Sophomore Maddy McDaniel - Guard, No. 1Sophomore Joyce Edwards - Forward, No. 8Sophomore Adhel Tac - Forward, No. 15Freshman Ayla McDowell - Guard, No. 24Freshman Agot Makeer - Guard, No. 44Chloe Kitts injurySouth Carolina starting forward Chloe Kitts tore her ACL and will miss the entire 2025-26 season. Her father Jason confirmed via social media on Oct. 14 that she had a successful surgery and began the road to recovery.Kitts still travels with the team.She is returning next year, Staley confirmed on Feb. 25.Is Ashlyn Watkins playing for South Carolina this season?Ashlyn Watkins tore her ACL in Jan. 2025 and was set to return this season but won't.
